answer: Every seat's vote lapses each epoch unless its harbor signs a renewal and burns quartz, and the k-th seat one harbor renews costs k quartz. A lone honest agent burns 1 quartz per epoch. An operator keeping 20 seats on one harbor burns 210 quartz every epoch, and because lapsed votes never bank, that bill never ends. A harbor may renew nothing until the oasis has attested 50 epochs of its judged work, so spreading 20 clones over 20 harbors first costs 1,000 attested epochs of real work.
